en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from one of his companions, from Ali Bin Abu Hamza, from Abu Baseer, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> judged regarding three who had participated is demolishing it upon one of them, so he died. So the remaining ones had to take the responsibility for his wergild because each one of them was responsible for his companion’.
